english: QuestionAs regards the usage in the said country, what is the condition of its reliability? Is it learning and culture? Or the connection of the particular country is the only condition, and the practices of the ignorant and the uncultured also arc authoritative? We ask this because if "learning" and "culture" are not regarded as necessary conditions, then the two qualifications mentioned in the sixth versein the phrase "the Practice of good and learned men" become futile.
